results.content: Unser Artikel zum Selbstverständnis von Gründerinnen ist Open Access bei Springer veröffentlicht und damit nun für alle einlesbar! 📄 How women tech founders navigate visibility in the startup ecosystem 2026 has started on a high note: our article “Doing, redoing, or undoing gender of women tech founders in Germany” has just been published in the International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal by Springer Nature 🎉 Together with Melanie Slavici, I examined how women tech founders in Germany navigate gender and visibility. This research emerged from our project on the visibility of female founders, funded by the German Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt and embedded in the Metavorhaben „Innovative Frauen im Fokus“ (meta-IFiF).
